 Cameron (1974) 623 points out that the line may allude to the flags of Minutemen militias in the
American Revolution, which featured a coiled rattlesnake and the motto ‘Don’t Tread on Me’. Some of
them added ‘Liberty or Death’. During the Revolution, American ships also flew a flag showing a snake
and the ‘Don’t Tread on Me’ motto. If S. intended the allusion, its revolutionary reference is a pointed
one. See L&C 280, 368–9 and notes.
